description: Look up full details for a single mobile app — title, developer, ratings, downloads/installs, category, price, and more. For Android pass the package name via `app_id` (e.g. "com.facebook.katana"); for iOS pass the numeric App Store id (e.g. "284882215"). Example: fortytwo_app_lookup({ platform: "android", app_id: "com.facebook.katana", _apiKey: "your-token" })

_apiKey.description: 42matters API access token (get one at https://42matters.com/pricing).

app_country.description: Optional 2-letter country code for pricing/availability metadata (default "US").

app_id.description: Android package name (e.g. "com.facebook.katana") or iOS App Store numeric id (e.g. "284882215").

platform.description: App store to query: "android" (Google Play) or "ios" (Apple App Store). Defaults to "android".

name: fortytwo_app_lookup
title: Fortytwo App Lookup
